theorems.name: Submission.sff_projection_field_fderiv_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (Q : Rn N → (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)) (x₀ : Rn n), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (ψ x₀) → (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, ∀ v : Rn n, Q (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x v) = fderiv ℝ ψ x v) → ∀ a b : Rn n, fderiv ℝ Q (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ b) = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x₀ a b - Q (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x₀ a b)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
